g.text: Two facts at different grains share dim_year and dim_region. Names and types as in docs/contract/gold_schema.yml.
Keys are enforced by construction and by the tests, not by Delta constraints (C2-C6). facility_key is the ordinal
of facility_id within the gold window (C4): join on it, never hard-code it. dim_facility.region_code is an
attribute only: the region reaches the beds fact directly, so the model stays a pure star with no ambiguous path.
